metadata.description: Isolated elastic LAB AWS original capacity adapter

action_catalog.description: Create only through the original scoped LAB grant; ambiguous sends are not replayed.
action_catalog.name: ensure_ec2_instance

action_catalog.description: Read-only original create disposition: accepted-tuple resource/auxiliary absence, or the explicit aws_original_authorization_denied_read_request_v1 discriminator proving one original denied RunInstances request and a complete same-client-token instance census. Denied mode does not reconstruct an HTTP response or claim volume/interface absence. No create, terminate, grant, witness, enrollment, business or savings authority.
action_catalog.name: observe_original_create_disposition

action_catalog.description: Observe a complete non-atomic original-capacity profile census through bounded native pagination and every exact configured slot Name. Revalidates physical membership; reports no enrollment, fencing, readiness or business authority.
action_catalog.name: observe_fleet_inventory

action_catalog.description: Observe a standalone EC2 instance's live state and IP addresses via DescribeInstances. A missing instance is reported as found:false, not an error.
action_catalog.name: observe_ec2_instance

action_catalog.description: Terminate only through the original scoped LAB retirement grant; ambiguous sends are not replayed.
action_catalog.name: terminate_ec2_instance

grant_bearer.description: Private existing Core mutation principal token for opt-in original_capacity only; never a workflow input.

original_capacity_bootstrap.description: Private approved bootstrap bodies keyed by the legacy profile bootstrap_key or selected slot_bootstraps entry; whole object is sensitive.

profile.description: Optional shared config profile name when the worker should use local AWS profiles.

original_capacity.description: Opt-in fixed original EC2 capacity v1 config; closed profiles with exclusive legacy bootstrap or complete sorted per-slot bootstrap keys/SHA256, actual source pin and existing grant service. Generic name-adopting governance is unavailable on a configured instance.
